NoticeState.broken: A broken item doesn't function normally (armor: AC penalty; shield: no Shield Block; weapon: unusable). It needs repair.

Dur.Title: Durability
Dur.NoHp: No Hit Points yet — apply its material's stats.
Dur.GiveHint: Sets Hardness and HP from the GM Core material table (precious materials by grade).
Dur.GiveAll: Apply material stats to all gear
Dur.RepairHint: Repair: Crafting check (DC {dc}). Success +{n} HP, critical success +{c} HP, critical failure 2d6 damage. Requires a repair toolkit.
Dur.NoRepairer: Choose a character to Repair (uses Crafting).
Dur.Hint: Damage to an item is reduced by its Hardness before it loses HP. At or below the Broken Threshold (BT, the line on the bar) it's broken; at 0 HP it's destroyed and can't be repaired. Click a bar to type its HP. Anyone can Repair (10 minutes) with their own character.
Dur.BarHint: Click and type its Hit Points (Enter saves, Esc cancels)
Dur.MaterialHint: Changing the material resets Hardness, HP and BT to that material's standard values (thin or standard grade)

Upkeep.Title: After the Fight
Upkeep.WearSaid: Gear worn down during the fight:
Upkeep.Hint: Party status after the fight: HP, conditions, Focus Points and gear worn down this fight. You can award XP to everyone below.

Craft.Title: Crafting
Craft.NoFormulas: No formulas. You can also drop an item here.
Craft.PickHint: Pick a formula on the left or drop an item here.
Craft.SetupHint: Remaster rules: {n} day(s) of setup before the check (1 with the formula, 2 without). On a success you pay for raw materials (half the Price); after that, each day of work takes the amount below off the remaining cost. You can finish at any time by paying the rest.
Craft.Facts: {days} day(s) worked · {per}/day · {left} left · free in {free} day(s)
Craft.FinishHint: Pay the remaining cost and finish now.
Craft.AbandonAsk: Abandon this project? Materials already paid for aren't refunded (nothing is paid before the check).
Craft.Drop: Drop an item from a compendium or the sidebar onto this window to craft it.

Need.Level: The item's level ({n}) is above the character's.
Need.Formula: Not in the formula book (ask the GM).

Craft.Fail: {item}: Crafting check failed — no materials lost. You can try again.
Craft.CritFail: {item}: Crafting critical failure — lost {lost} of materials.
Craft.Started: {item}: work begins — paid {materials} for materials. Progress {per}/day; free in {days} day(s).
Craft.FinishedPaid: {item} complete! Paid the remaining {paid} after {days} day(s).
Craft.FinishedFree: {item} complete! Finished after {days} day(s) of work at no extra cost.
Craft.SetupStarted: {item}: setup begins — Crafting check in {days} day(s). Have {materials} ready for materials (spent only on a success).
Craft.CheckNow: {item}: setup complete — roll the Crafting check.
Craft.SetupDone: {item}: setup complete — roll the Crafting check (DC {dc}) at the workbench.
Craft.EffectSetupDesc: {left} day(s) of setup left · then a DC {dc} Crafting check
Craft.FactsSetup: {n} day(s) of setup left · materials {materials} (paid on a success)

Clock.plan: Work days are counted from Craft hours in the day planner (Rutz's PF2e Days); 8 hours = 1 day.
Clock.time: Each day that passes on the world clock counts as a day of work.
Clock.manual: Work days are counted with this window's +1 day button.

Settings.AutoStatsHint: When a character gains a weapon or armor, give it Hardness and HP by material (only items without HP).
Settings.BarsHint: Show an HP bar next to weapons, armor and shields in the inventory. Click it to open the durability window.
Settings.NoticeHint: Post to chat when an item loses Hit Points.
Settings.BrokenArmorHint: Broken equipped gear adds a 'Broken: …' effect to the character (armor: AC penalty). Removed once repaired.
Settings.WearHint: Gear wears down a little during fights.
Settings.WearHardnessHint: Off: wear ignores Hardness (gradual wear and tear). On: wear lower than Hardness is blocked.
Settings.UpkeepHint: When to show the party status / XP window after an encounter.
Settings.DailyRateHint: Multiplies the amount a day of work takes off (Earn Income table). 2 = twice as fast.
Settings.SetupDaysHint: −1 = by the rules (1 day with the formula, 2 without). 0 or more: that many days.
Settings.NoticeToHint: Who sees damage, repair and broken-item messages.
Settings.NoticeOwners: The character's players and the GM
Settings.BrokenRuleHint: By the rules a broken item can't be used normally. Default: an attack penalty (usable, but poorly).
Settings.BrokenRaw: Rules as written (a 'can't be used' reminder only)
Settings.WearModeHint: 'Combat log': armor rolls each time its wearer is hit, a weapon each time it deals damage. No hits, no wear.
Settings.WearTimingHint: 'Live' (default): gear wears the moment it's hit or deals damage (a number pops up over the token) and can break mid-fight, with one summary at the end. 'At the end of the fight': all at once afterwards.
Settings.WearEnd: At the end of the fight
Settings.WearChanceHint: Rolled (d100) for each hit taken (armor) or damage dealt (weapon); the item loses 1 HP on a success. Default 5%: six hits in a fight ≈ 26% chance of losing 1.
Settings.UpkeepPublicHint: Off: the after-fight summary is sent to the GM only.
Settings.CraftClockHint: What advances a crafting project by a day.
Settings.ClockAuto: Auto (day planner with Rutz's PF2e Days, otherwise the world clock)
Settings.ClockPlan: Craft hours in the day planner
Settings.LiveNoticeHint: For live wear. Default: nothing in chat, just one summary after the fight (one line per item). A number always pops up over the token.
Settings.LiveBroken: In chat only when it breaks
Settings.AmmoHint: After a fight, each arrow, bolt, etc. fired is recovered with this chance (not a rule — the GM's call). 0 = off.
Settings.AmmoMagic: Recover magical and alchemical ammunition too
Settings.AmmoMagicHint: Off (default): magical and alchemical ammunition is used up when fired.
Settings.BrokenPenaltyNHint: With 'Attack penalty': the status penalty to attack rolls with that weapon (default 1 → −1).
Settings.DestroyedHint: On (default): attack and damage rolls with a weapon at 0 HP are blocked, and destroyed armor and shields are unequipped.

Broken.Label: Broken: {name}
Broken.NoteRaw: By the rules a broken weapon doesn't function normally — it shouldn't be used until repaired (GM's call).

Desc.armor: Broken armor keeps its item bonus but takes a status penalty to AC (−1 light, −2 medium, −3 heavy).
Desc.weapon: Broken weapon. By the rules it doesn't function normally; depending on the setting it gives an attack penalty or clumsy. Removed once repaired.
Desc.gone: A destroyed weapon (0 HP). It can't be used or repaired.

Broken.NoteGone: A destroyed weapon can't be used.
Broken.Blocked: {item} is destroyed: it can't be used or repaired (find a replacement, or ask the GM).
Broken.Off: {actor}'s {item} is destroyed and unequipped — no AC, no Shield Block.
